column1: # Stuck mailboxes someone has looked at. The sync-stuck watchdog
# (scripts/check-sync-*.sh) still lists them on every run, as warnings,
# and turns red only for a stuck mailbox that is not here.
#   mailbox_account_id  stuck_since (UTC, from the watchdog output)  acknowledged_on  note
# An entry matches only that mailbox at that stuck-since instant: if the
# mailbox is retried and fails again, it is new again.
# This repository is public. Notes carry no names, email addresses or
# message data — only what is known and who owns it.
